name: Remifi
description: Send cross border remittances on Celo using stablecoins. Talk in English, Spanish, Portuguese, or French. Remifi quotes Mento routes, compares fees against banks, and settles on chain in seconds. remifi.xyz · api.remifi.xyz · Telegram @remifi_bot

skills.name: Send remittance
skills.description: Quote and send cross-border stablecoin remittances on Celo via Mento.
examples: Send $50 to my mom in the Philippines
Enviar 50 dólares a mi mamá en Filipinas

skills.name: Get quote
skills.description: Get a live Mento route quote with fee comparison vs banks.
examples: How much to send €50 to Brazil?

skills.name: Check balance
skills.description: Look up on-chain USDC and stablecoin balances on Celo.

skills.name: Resolve contact
skills.description: Match a recipient name to a saved contact or wallet.

skills.name: Compare fees
skills.description: Compare Remifi fees and savings against traditional remittance.
examples: How much do I save vs Western Union?

skills.name: Multilingual intent
skills.description: Parse remittance requests in English, Spanish, Portuguese, or French.

skills.name: Claim escrow
skills.description: Look up and claim phone-only escrow transfers.

skills.name: Transfer history
skills.description: List past remittance transactions and statuses.

skills.name: x402 payments
skills.description: Pay for premium quotes via HTTP 402 micropayments on Celo.

skills.name: Manage contacts
skills.description: Add, sync, or import recipient contacts for remittances.
